name: Liquid Zoom
description: Endless zoom-through built from four phase-offset parallax layers composited back-to-front by scene depth, each owning two FFT bins so the stack pulses through the spectrum. Replaces the previous two-layer version whose depth write picked a dominant layer with a hard threshold that popped on every crossing. Clicks emit bounded zoom pulses.

updatedParams.name: Near Layer Speed
updatedParams.description: Zoom cadence for near (low-depth) pixels — maps to zoom_params.x.

updatedParams.name: Far Layer Speed
updatedParams.description: Zoom cadence for far (high-depth) pixels — maps to zoom_params.y.

updatedParams.name: Parallax Strength
updatedParams.description: Exponent shaping the depth-to-speed curve — maps to zoom_params.z.

updatedParams.name: Fog Density
updatedParams.description: Distance fog applied to far layers — maps to zoom_params.w.
